description: Published vector values that changed between mvp-0.2-baseline.12 and mvp-0.4-baseline.1, each with the decision that approved it. Checked by scripts/check-baseline-changes.mjs; any other changed or removed value fails validation.

changed.from: C1 with the reserved core Control Record type 9
changed.to: C1 with the reserved core Control Record type 31
changed.rule: Orchestrator decision (2026-11-03), ADR 0011 and LFCP-WIRE-01 §14: type 9 is DEVICE_GRANT since IDENTITY-01, so the record no longer demonstrates an unknown core type (an identity-aware receiver rejects these bytes as MALFORMED_MESSAGE, since the body is not a device-grant-body). The case moves to type 31, the last reserved core code, so that it stays an unknown core type for the longest time; its rule, expected code and base case are unchanged.
